title: Unexplained mass caught as rockets destroyed

tellings.quote: a an unexplained mass that was actually documented in tandem with the rockets being destroyed in some of those launches above the triangle,

plain: Rockets launched over a spot called "the triangle" on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of strange happenings, were destroyed in flight, and at the same moment an "unexplained mass" was recorded. The ranch's owner says this on the show as someone who was there. If it happened as he says, it would suggest that something unseen over that spot was linked to the rockets being destroyed.
